#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;

const int maxn=55, maxt=2*maxn;
const int inf=1e9;

struct Edge {
    int b, l, c, ne;
};

int N, M, K, C, D;
int cnt[maxn];
int id[maxn][maxt];
int S = 1, E = 2, pct = 2;
bool flag[maxt * maxn + 10];
int dis[maxt * maxn + 10];
int ans;
queue<int> q;
vector<Edge> eg;
vector<int> head;

inline void addEdge(int a, int b, int c, int l) {
    eg.push_back({b, l, c, head[a]});
    head[a] = (int)eg.size() - 1;
}

inline void addPair(int a, int b, int c, int l) {
    addEdge(a, b, c, l);
    addEdge(b, a, -c, 0);
}

inline char gc() {
    return getchar();
}

inline ll rd() {
    ll x = 0; char c = gc(); bool neg = 0;
    while (c < '0' || c > '9') { if (c == '-') neg = 1; c = gc(); }
    while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') x = (x << 1) + (x << 3) + c - '0', c = gc();
    return neg ? (~x + 1) : x;
}

inline bool spfa() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= pct; ++i) flag[i] = 0, dis[i] = inf;
    dis[S] = 0; q.push(S);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int p = q.front(); q.pop();
        flag[p] = 0;
        for (int i = head[p]; i != -1; i = eg[i].ne) {
            if (!eg[i].l) continue;
            int b = eg[i].b;
            if (dis[b] > dis[p] + eg[i].c) {
                dis[b] = dis[p] + eg[i].c;
                if (!flag[b]) {
                    q.push(b);
                    flag[b] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[E] < inf;
}

int dinic(int x, int y) {
    if (x == S) return y;
    flag[x] = 1;
    int tmp = y;
    for (int i = head[x]; i != -1; i = eg[i].ne) {
        int b = eg[i].b;
        if (flag[b] || !eg[i ^ 1].l || dis[x] < dis[b] + eg[i ^ 1].c) continue;
        int re = dinic(b, min(tmp, eg[i ^ 1].l));
        if (re) {
            tmp -= re;
            eg[i ^ 1].l -= re;
            eg[i].l += re;
            if (!tmp) break;
        }
    }
    return y - tmp;
}

int main() {
    N = rd(); M = rd(); K = rd(); C = rd(); D = rd();
    head.assign(maxt * maxn + 10, -1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= K; ++i) cnt[rd()]++;
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= K + M + 2; ++j) {
            id[i][j] = ++pct;
            if (i == 1) addPair(id[i][j], E, C * (j - 1), inf);
            if (j > 1) addPair(id[i][j - 1], id[i][j], 0, inf);
        }
        if (cnt[i]) addPair(S, id[i][1], 0, cnt[i]);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= M; ++i) {
        int a = rd(), b = rd();
        for (int j = 1; j <= K + M + 1; ++j) {
            for (int k = 1; k <= 2 * K - 1; k += 2) {
                addPair(id[a][j], id[b][j + 1], k * D, 1);
                addPair(id[b][j], id[a][j + 1], k * D, 1);
            }
        }
    }
    int nn = 0;
    while (spfa()) {
        int aa = -1;
        while (aa) {
            memset(flag, 0, sizeof(flag));
            aa = dinic(E, inf);
            nn += aa;
            ans += dis[E] * aa;
        }
    }
    assert(nn == K);
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}

#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;

const int maxn = 55, maxt = 2 * maxn, maxp = maxt * maxn + 5, maxe = 5 * maxt * maxn * maxn + 5;
const int inf = 1e9;

struct Edge { int b, l, c, ne; };

class MinCostFlow {
public:
    int N, M, K, C, D;
    int cnt[maxn];
    int id[maxn][maxt];
    int S = 1, E = 2, pct = 2;
    bool flag[maxp];
    int dis[maxp];
    int ans = 0;
    Edge eg[maxe];
    int ect = 1;
    int egh[maxp];
    deque<int> q;

    inline void adeg(int a, int b, int c, int l) {
        eg[++ect] = {b, l, c, egh[a]};
        egh[a] = ect;
    }
    inline void ade(int a, int b, int c, int l) {
        adeg(a, b, c, l);
        adeg(b, a, -c, 0);
    }
    inline ll rd() {
        ll x = 0; char c = getchar(); bool neg = 0;
        while (c < '0' || c > '9') { if (c == '-') neg = 1; c = getchar(); }
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') x = (x << 1) + (x << 3) + c - '0', c = getchar();
        return neg ? (~x + 1) : x;
    }
    bool spfa() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= pct; ++i) flag[i] = 0, dis[i] = inf;
        dis[S] = 0; q.push_back(S);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int p = q.front(); q.pop_front();
            flag[p] = 0;
            for (int i = egh[p]; i; i = eg[i].ne) {
                if (!eg[i].l) continue;
                int b = eg[i].b;
                if (dis[b] > dis[p] + eg[i].c) {
                    dis[b] = dis[p] + eg[i].c;
                    if (!flag[b]) {
                        flag[b] = 1;
                        if (!q.empty() && dis[b] < dis[q.front()]) q.push_front(b);
                        else q.push_back(b);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dis[E] < inf;
    }
    int dinic(int x, int y) {
        if (x == S) return y;
        flag[x] = 1;
        int tmp = y;
        for (int i = egh[x]; i; i = eg[i].ne) {
            int b = eg[i].b;
            if (flag[b] || !eg[i ^ 1].l || dis[x] < dis[b] + eg[i ^ 1].c) continue;
            int re = dinic(b, min(tmp, eg[i ^ 1].l));
            if (re) {
                tmp -= re;
                eg[i ^ 1].l -= re;
                eg[i].l += re;
                if (!tmp) break;
            }
        }
        return y - tmp;
    }
    void solve() {
        memset(egh, 0, sizeof(egh));
        memset(cnt, 0, sizeof(cnt));
        N = rd(); M = rd(); K = rd(); C = rd(); D = rd();
        for (int i = 1; i <= K; ++i) cnt[rd()]++;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= K + M + 2; ++j) {
                id[i][j] = ++pct;
                if (i == 1) ade(id[i][j], E, C * (j - 1), inf);
                if (j > 1) ade(id[i][j - 1], id[i][j], 0, inf);
            }
            if (cnt[i]) ade(S, id[i][1], 0, cnt[i]);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= M; ++i) {
            int a = rd(), b = rd();
            for (int j = 1; j <= K + M + 1; ++j) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= 2 * K - 1; k += 2) {
                    ade(id[a][j], id[b][j + 1], k * D, 1);
                    ade(id[b][j], id[a][j + 1], k * D, 1);
                }
            }
        }
        int nn = 0;
        while (spfa()) {
            int aa = -1;
            while (aa) {
                memset(flag, 0, sizeof(flag));
                aa = dinic(E, inf);
                nn += aa;
                ans += dis[E] * aa;
            }
        }
        assert(nn == K);
        printf("%d\n", ans);
    }
};

int main() {
    MinCostFlow solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
